referents.why: 'his hand': the one who stretched out, Aaron (3ms).
'she covered': third feminine singular, the frogs (w12, feminine singular collective).

links.why: then runs within a verse only; across the verse boundary it is not used.
Aaron's stretching out brings about the frogs' coming up: a clause stating what an act brings about is result, not then.
links.category: act then its result read as then

links.why: the act of stretching out the hand, and what it brings about: the frogs came up (R4).
wayyiqtol continues the narrative line: the frogs came up, then covered the land.

cant_tell.what: whether cl0 (Aaron stretched out his hand) fulfils the command Exo.8.1#cl2 (stretch out your hand)
cant_tell.why: the verb is repeated in a narrative report with a named subject, but there is no pro-form (ken or asah) as the fulfils condition requires; not linked.
